idea_name: LSTM vs GRU gated sequence classifiers for FX direction
mechanism: Sequential OHLC windows feed LSTM (forget/input/output gates + cell state) or GRU (update/reset gates); Optuna-tuned classifiers export to ONNX and run in Strategy Tester; feature-importance comparison between architectures.
data_needed: time_step sequential feature tensors; encoded direction labels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: forex series from prior DS/ML parts (EURUSD-style OHLC windows)
why_new_for_mis: Explicit long-memory gated recurrent sensors for regime-sensitive sequence forecasting, contrasting LSTM cell vs GRU gates.
quote: Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM), is a type of recurrent neural network designed for sequence tasks, excelling in capturing and utilizing long-term dependencies in data.

idea_name: 1D CNN on price windows as local-pattern sensor
mechanism: Conv1D(filters, kernel_size) + pooling over (window_size, features) tensors extracts local motifs; Softmax classifier ~57% OOS; saved cnn.EURUSD.D1.onnx for EA.
data_needed: windowed multivariate bars; MinMax/Standard scaler params
why_new_for_mis: Treats short sliding windows as spatial grids for convolutional motif sensing rather than recurrent memory.
quote: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are a class of deep learning algorithms specifically designed to process structured grid-like data, such as images, audio spectrograms, and time-series data.

idea_name: NumPy-like matrix toolkit including FFT in MQL5
mechanism: CNumpy wraps matrices/vectors with init, stats, RNG, FFT, linalg—developer tooling to port Python algos, not a market sensor itself.
why_new_for_mis: Library article; sensing would come from algorithms built with it, not from the article’s own formulas.
quote: we will implement some of the most useful functions and methods from NumPy in MQL5 using a very close syntax to make it much easier to translate algorithms from Python

idea_name: Cross-symbol CNN transfer learning for shared technical patterns
mechanism: Train base CNN on rich symbol (e.g. EURUSD); freeze/reuse early layers and fine-tune on data-poor related FX/metal symbols; deploy basesymbol=X.symbol=Y ONNX in EA.
data_needed: OHLC (and TA features) across many symbols D1/H4; base + target windows
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD|GBPUSD|AUDUSD|…|XAUUSD etc.; PERIOD_D1 collection; EA example H4
why_new_for_mis: Senses transferable cross-market technical structure via pretrained feature extractors when local history is thin.
quote: all markets tend to go up and down, similar candlestick patterns across all markets are displayed, indicators exhibit similar patterns on different instruments

idea_name: Calendar news actual/forecast/previous as AI features
mechanism: CalendarValueHistory per bar for currencies in Symbol; store sector, importance, actual/forecast/previous with OHLC; train classifier and trade via news+AI EA.
data_needed: MqlCalendarEvent/Value history; OHLC aligned to news times
why_new_for_mis: Fundamental/event sensor channel (surprise vs forecast) fused with price for MIS beyond pure technicals.
quote: we are going to use news information offered by MetaTrader 5 to AI models and see if this powerful combination is the real deal in algorithmic trading.

idea_name: Fibonacci 0.618 breakout labels from rolling high-low
mechanism: create_fib_clftargetvar: fib_level_value=high-(high-low)*fib_level over lookback; label 1/0/-1 if price_ahead breaches fib up/down/neither; train clf/reg and tester EAs.
why_new_for_mis: Geometric retracement level as supervised target/sensor for reversal vs continuation relative to swing range.
quote: fib_level_value = high - (high - low) * fib_level # calculate the Fibonacci level in market price

idea_name: LGMM soft clusters of indicator space as latent regime features
mechanism: Fit GaussianMixture/LGMM via EM on multi-indicator vectors (Force, MACD, RSI, Stoch, …); emit LATENT_FEATURE_k posteriors/means; feed RF classifier; latent features rank high in Gini importance.
data_needed: panel of MT5 indicator values (XAUUSD example); n_components via selection
why_new_for_mis: Unsupervised soft regime embedding of indicator configurations—hidden pattern sensor for MIS.
quote: In financial markets, these latent variables can represent underlying trading patterns in the data that we often misinterpret or miss out.

idea_name: K-means exclusive clustering with Elbow/WCSS for k
mechanism: CKMeans assigns points to nearest centroid via rectilinear (or Euclidean) distance; iterates until stable; ElbowMethod plots WCSS vs k to pick cluster count for market/feature grouping.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: demo matrix; EURUSD M1 test harness mentioned in logs
why_new_for_mis: Classic unsupervised regime partitioning of multivariate market features with principled k selection.
quote: The k-means algorithm is a method of vector quantization, that aims to partition n observations into k clusters in which each observation belongs to the cluster with the nearest mean

idea_name: Simple RNN sequential memory for FX window forecasting
mechanism: Hidden state h_t=σ(W_xh x_t + W_hh h_{t-1}+b_h) over time_step windows; regression/classification Keras SimpleRNN→ONNX EA; notes vanishing gradients motivating LSTM/GRU.
data_needed: sequential OHLC/feature windows; targets for next bar or class
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: forex timeseries from prior article pipeline
why_new_for_mis: Baseline recurrent sequence sensor establishing short-term memory limits that later gated models fix.
quote: RNNs have something called sequential memory, which refers to the concept of retaining and utilizing information from the previous time steps in a sequence
